 Dengue Alert in the Marshall Islands: 156 positive cases and 13 hospitalizations
 October 21, 2026
 By Fundación iO Team 
 156 positive Dengue cases are reported in Majuro and Ebeye, Marshall Islands, with 13 hospitalizations. Between 08/15 and 10/15/2026, 501 samples were analyzed, resulting in 124 cases in Majuro and 32 in Ebeye. Positivity is 30% in Majuro and 36% in Ebeye. DENV-1 was detected. Vector control measures, fumigation, and enhanced surveillance have been implemented. On 10/08, a state of disaster was declared due to El Niño and the dengue outbreak, with response plans and sanitary measures for prolonged drought and infrastructure damage.
